output.question: What is Samsung's annual revenue?
output.answer: Samsung Electronics' latest full fiscal year is FY2025 (calendar 2025). Its revenue was KRW 333.6 trillion, the highest it has ever reported, and operating profit was KRW 43.6 trillion. Samsung released these figures on January 29, 2026. Fourth-quarter 2025 revenue was also a quarterly record at KRW 93.8 trillion. Full-year 2026 results won't come out until about late January 2027.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' FY2025 revenue was KRW 333.6 trillion.
Samsung Electronics' FY2025 operating profit was KRW 43.6 trillion.
Q4 2025 revenue was KRW 93.8 trillion, the highest quarterly consolidated revenue the company has reported.

passages.quote: For the full year, the Company reported KRW 333.6 trillion in annual revenue and KRW 43.6 trillion in operating profit.
the Company posted its highest-ever quarterly consolidated revenue at KRW 93.8 trillion

caveats: This answer takes 'Samsung' to mean Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. The figure does not cover the whole Samsung Group or other affiliates such as Samsung C&T, Samsung SDI or Samsung Life.

Revenue is consolidated and reported in Korean won. Media conversions to US dollars vary with the exchange rate used, from roughly $231 billion to $247 billion. I didn't check any USD figure against a primary source.
Media reports put year-on-year revenue growth at about 11%. I didn't confirm that on the primary page I opened.
FY2025 is the latest complete fiscal year. Samsung has released quarterly results for 2026, including Q3 2026 in late October, but I didn't retrieve a trailing-twelve-month figure.
The global newsroom URL timed out, so the figures were read from the identical release on Samsung's Belgium newsroom.
